description: Unofficial static recompilation of the Xbox 360 version of Need for Speed: Most Wanted (2005): a native port for Steam Deck, Steam Machine, Steam Frame, Linux and Mac (iPhone/iPad: sideload the experimental IPA or build it yourself). Bring your own disc: no game files included. Not affiliated with EA or Valve.
